fusions.name: Pinched Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark at the first enemy in line up to 8 tiles away, dealing 4 damage with a 20% chance to leave it [Dimmed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell Snatched Whole
fusions.desc: Snatches the spell from one enemy within 7 tiles: deals 28 damage, ignoring its resistances, and silences it for 4 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Pocketed Arcana
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana at once, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Brimming Fingers
fusions.desc: The moment your mana fills, your next strike has 15% more critical chance. Once every 20 seconds.
